author: zerocool413
quote: This is the single most meticulously detailed game I've ever played. Everything in it feels so alive. Its so dense and rich. I love the Bonnie and Clyde vibe of the main characters. The shootouts are insane, it reminds me of the movie Heat. The driving is great. The customization of your characters and vehicles is also great. Even the tiny details like sharing a cigarette with Lucia just adds to the immersion. Goty without a doubt.

game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: zerocool413
quote: I love the freedom in this game, you do and be whoever you want from the very beginning, the soundtrack is amazing, the atmosphere when exploring is very immersive.  The ship building is awesome. And mods make it wayy better. Bethesda made an epic foundation to build upon for years.
